objective: Fix V3.2 defects: (1) CLAIM_IDENTITY_VALIDATION to prevent cross-patent contamination, (2) SEARCH_RECALL to >=80%, (3) rebuild 103 with explicit evidence object, COULD!=WOULD rule, combination matrix, two-pass anti-hindsight.

root_causes: CLAIM_IDENTITY_FAILURE: CV2_A_01/CV2_A_02 had PatSnap claims for different patents than case metadata
103_FAILURE: 103 accuracy 15% — OBVIOUSNESS_ADVERSARY too lenient, no COULD/WOULD distinction
SEARCH_FAILURE: search_recall 70% — not all families contributing to recall

v3_3_changes_from_v3_2: CLAIM_IDENTITY_VALIDATION: validate case patent number vs retrieved patent number vs title vs assignee vs priority date vs claim text
claim_subject_fingerprint: title + abstract + claim terminology + device class + technical mechanism
If IDENTITY_MISMATCH: STOP CASE, status=EVIDENCE_CORRUPTED, do NOT run 102/103/commercial/rescue

103 explicit evidence object: closest_prior_art + differences + objective_technical_problem + secondary_reference + motivation + technical_effect + expectation_of_success + teaching_away + could + would + why + hindsight
COULD != WOULD rule: OBVIOUSNESS_RISK requires WOULD=YES AND MOTIVATION_SUPPORTED=TRUE AND EXPECTED_SUCCESS_SUPPORTED=TRUE
Closest prior art must be technically close (similar purpose/effect OR closely related field)

103 combination matrix: REFERENCE_A + REFERENCE_B + ELEMENTS_FROM_A + ELEMENTS_FROM_B + MOTIVATION_TO_COMBINE + EXPECTED_BENEFIT + TECHNICAL_COMPATIBILITY + TEACHING_AWAY + PRE_FILING_REASON_TO_COMBINE
103 two-pass anti-hindsight: Pass A (hide solution) vs Pass B (reveal + compare). Large divergence = HINDSIGHT_RISK_HIGH
Technical effect: effect_source + effect_strength + documented/inferred/hypothesized. No commercial success substitute.
102 remains strict: one reference discloses all limitations + arrangement. Inherency requires necessity.

Model role separation: OBVIOUSNESS_ADVERSARY does NOT receive generator's narrative rationale. It receives canonical claim + prior art + claim mappings + technical evidence and constructs its own rationale.

Error attribution: CLAIM_IDENTITY_FAILURE / CLAIM_INTERPRETATION_FAILURE / SEARCH_FAILURE / 102_FAILURE / 103_FAILURE / HINDSIGHT_FAILURE / MODEL_JUDGMENT_FAILURE / GROUND_TRUTH_FAILURE / EVIDENCE_FAILURE

claim_identity_validation.rule: Before ANY claim enters the pipeline, validate identity
claim_identity_validation.on_mismatch: STOP CASE. Do NOT run 102/103/commercial/rescue. Status=EVIDENCE_CORRUPTED.

claim_subject_fingerprint.rule: Compare fingerprint to case metadata. If similarity is materially inconsistent: CLAIM_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.

obviousness_103_rules.could_would_rule: COULD = capability. WOULD = evidence of motivation + expectation of success. OBVIOUSNESS_RISK requires WOULD=YES AND MOTIVATION_SUPPORTED=TRUE AND EXPECTED_SUCCESS_SUPPORTED=TRUE.
obviousness_103_rules.closest_prior_art_selection: Similar purpose/effect OR same/closely related field AND minimal structural/functional modification. Do NOT select a convenient patent merely because it shares one keyword.

two_pass_anti_hindsight.pass_a: Hide the final invention solution. Ask: 'What would a skilled person do to solve the objective problem?'
two_pass_anti_hindsight.pass_b: Reveal the actual claimed invention. Compare.

obviousness_103_rules.technical_effect: For each distinguishing feature: effect_source + effect_strength + documented/inferred/hypothesized. If unexpected and technically significant, require evidence linking effect to claimed feature. Do NOT use commercial success as substitute.

novelty_102_rules.single_reference_rule: One reference must disclose all limitations + required arrangement.

model_role_separation.obviousness_adversary_isolation: OBVIOUSNESS_ADVERSARY must NOT receive the generator's narrative rationale. It receives: canonical claim + prior art + claim mappings + technical evidence. It constructs its own rationale.

stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3.3 reaches all thresholds including 102>=85% and 103>=80%.
